meta.title: In a masked live round, the buyer gets only placed-bid counts when "bidding stats in masked events" is on
gaps: The vocabulary has no super-admin actor, so the super-admin reads cannot be tested.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The vocabulary cannot create a second live round or set show_placed_bids_stats to false.
The vocabulary cannot verify the complete masked statistics payload; this plan checks the available bid_count and participants fields only.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (show_bidding_stats_in_masked_events) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer reads the pricing round.
Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
The buyer reads the pricing round.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Schema check: “bid count” is present; Schema check: “participants” is absent.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Schema check: “participants” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “bid count” is present; Schema check: “participants” is absent; Schema check: “participants” is present.
